title: Roach project health commands
description: .agent/VERIFY.json. These commands are repository-supplied executable text and run with the privileges of whoever invokes Roach -- see docs/SECURITY.md before running them in a repository you did not write.

required_level.description: The level that must pass before a project can be marked complete.

setup.description: Optional preparation for a fresh CI checkout -- dependency install, generated assets. Not run by local verify or integrate, which assume a prepared environment.

command.description: A string runs through the platform shell, which is cmd.exe on Windows and /bin/sh elsewhere. An array runs directly with no shell, which is portable across operating systems and is the better choice for a project that may be opened on more than one. null means not configured.
